title: Justice in Judgment: Unveiling (Hidden) Bias in LLM-assisted Peer Reviews

bias_targets.methodology: Counterfactual interventions modifying the author's university affiliation (Ranked-Stronger vs. Ranked-Weaker institutions) in the prompt to measure differences in LLM-generated peer review ratings.
Counterfactual name substitution using traditionally Anglo male versus female author names in the prompt to evaluate differences in LLM-generated peer review scores.
Comparing LLM review ratings by changing the author's explicitly stated career stage (Senior Principal Investigator vs. Undergraduate Student) within the prompt metadata.
Modifying the author's reported publication record (e.g., 100 top-tier publications vs. 0 publications) in the prompt to measure its impact on the final LLM-generated review score.
